articles.title: US Corporate Debt Wall: $4.3 trillion maturities loom from 2027
articles.content: Around $4.3 trillion of US corporate bonds are set to mature between 2027 and 2031, increasing refinancing pressure as borrowing costs remain elevated. Lower-rated companies face greater risks, while major technology firms are also expected to raise substantial debt for AI infrastructure, potentially intensifying corporate credit supply and financing costs.

articles.title: Rupee pinned just shy of 96/USD as RBI intervention counters oil woes
articles.content: The Indian rupee experienced a slight dip as surging oil prices emerged from stalled diplomacy between the US and Iran. With escalating tensions across the Middle East, Brent crude oil rose considerably. To counteract further declines, the Reserve Bank of India stepped in to ensure the rupee remained above the 96 per dollar threshold. Consequently, India's foreign exchange reserves fell, reflecting these currency stabilization efforts.
